title: Can I Build the Bridge?
can_do: 礼貌请求加入正在进行的游戏，并尊重同伴已经搭好的部分。
trigger: A peer is building a car road alone, and the child wants to contribute without taking it over.
stretch_response: Can I build a bridge beside your road?
repair_response: Okay, I won't move your road. Can I build here?
setting: Free play with blocks and cars.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: I'm making a road for these cars.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: That looks fun. Can I play with you?

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Okay, but don't move my road.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Okay. Can I build a bridge beside your road?

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Yes, then our cars can cross together.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Great. I will start the bridge here.

replay_cards.title: Join the animal home
replay_cards.change: A peer has already made one animal house
replay_cards.challenge: Ask to join, accept that the first house stays, add a second house, and connect the play

replay_cards.title: Join the chalk road
replay_cards.change: A peer owns the current chalk line
replay_cards.challenge: Ask to join, learn where not to draw, add a parking place, and use both parts

parent_support: Play the peer as someone with a real idea and a reasonable boundary.
Joining succeeds through a useful contribution, not automatic access to every object.
